terms.label: biological_process
terms.definition: A biological process is a recognized series of events.

terms.label: cellular process
terms.definition: Any process that is carried out at the cellular level.

terms.label: cell communication
terms.definition: Any process that mediates interactions between a cell and its surroundings.

terms.label: signal transduction
terms.definition: The cellular process in which a signal is conveyed to trigger a change.

terms.label: cell surface receptor signaling pathway
terms.definition: A series of molecular signals initiated by activation of a receptor on the cell surface.
synonyms: cell surface receptor linked signal transduction

terms.label: apoptotic process
terms.definition: A programmed cell death process which begins when a cell receives an internal or external signal.

terms.label: cell cycle
terms.definition: The progression of biochemical and morphological phases occurring in a cell leading to its division.

terms.label: mitotic cell cycle
terms.definition: Progression through the phases of the mitotic cell cycle.

terms.label: nuclear division
terms.definition: The division of a cell nucleus into two nuclei.

terms.label: M phase
terms.definition: A cell cycle phase during which nuclear division occurs.

terms.label: metabolic process
terms.definition: The chemical reactions and pathways, including anabolism and catabolism.

terms.label: glycolytic process
terms.definition: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the breakdown of glucose into pyruvate.

terms.label: oxidative phosphorylation
terms.definition: The synthesis of ATP from ADP and phosphate coupled to electron transport.

terms.label: molecular_function
terms.definition: The elemental activity of a gene product at the molecular level.

terms.label: catalytic activity
terms.definition: Catalysis of a biochemical reaction at physiological temperatures.

terms.label: transferase activity
terms.definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a functional group from one compound to another.

terms.label: transferase activity, transferring phosphorus-containing groups
terms.definition: Catalysis of the transfer of a phosphorus-containing group.

terms.label: receptor activity
terms.definition: Combining with an extracellular or intracellular messenger to initiate a change in cell activity.

terms.label: transmembrane signaling receptor activity
terms.definition: Combining with a signal and transmitting the signal to initiate a change in cell activity.

terms.label: signaling receptor activity
terms.definition: Receiving a signal and transmitting it to initiate a change in cellular activity.
synonyms: receptor activity involved in signal transduction
